v0.3:
- Geiger clicks when tracking a frequency: the stronger the signal, the faster the crackle
- A new contact flashes the panel, buzzes and blinks the LED on every sensor
- Full sweep: progress bar across the pass, a chirp as each sensor takes over, and a report card at the end of every pass
- Filled header bar on every screen
- Stardate on the start-up screen
- Breathing LED in the active sensor's colour, with a menu switch
- TAG shows a notice and keeps retrying when another app holds the NFC chip, instead of crashing
- Fix a crash in every mode: the breathing LED handed the notification service a sequence that had already gone out of scope

v0.2:
- Full sweep tab that runs RF, IR, EMF and TAG in turn
- Sub-GHz waterfall view and protocol identification while tracking
- Infrared send and save
- Settings remembered between runs

v0.1:
First release
